title: WebCMS - Modern Python Content Management System
instructions: Build a production-ready WebCMS with HTTPS, plugin architecture, and template system. Core features: user management, content editing, media handling, theme support, plugin API, REST API, admin dashboard, SEO tools, caching, and secure deployment.

1783294271.626026.instruction: Create WebCMS directory structure: webcms/core/, webcms/plugins/, webcms/templates/, webcms/static/, webcms/media/, config/. Implement base Application class with WSGI/ASGI support. Create Request/Response wrappers. Build Router with URL patterns. Setup configuration system (YAML) for database, server, security. Implement dependency injection container for plugin management. Create entry point: run.py.

1783294271.6276176.instruction: Design SQLAlchemy models: User, Role, Permission, Page, Post, Category, Tag, Media, Plugin, Theme, AuditLog. Setup relationships: User-Roles (many-to-many), Post-Category (many-to-many), Post-Tag (many-to-many). Implement soft delete mixin with deleted_at timestamp. Add created_at/updated_at timestamps. Create Alembic migration system. Configure connection pooling. Add database indexes for performance.

1783294271.6279087.instruction: Implement JWT-based authentication with access/refresh tokens. Password hashing using bcrypt with salt. Role-based access control (RBAC): Admin, Editor, Author, Subscriber roles. Permission system: create_post, edit_post, delete_post, manage_users, etc. Session management with Redis backend. OAuth2 integration for Google/GitHub login. Implement password reset via email (SMTP). Add rate limiting for login attempts.

1783294271.6280518.instruction: Integrate Jinja2 template engine with custom filters (date_format, markdown, truncate). Create theme discovery system scanning templates/themes/ directory. Implement template inheritance: base.html with blocks (content, head, scripts). Build asset pipeline for CSS/JS minification. Create default responsive theme with navigation, sidebar, footer. Add theme configuration (theme.yaml). Implement template caching with Redis.

1783294271.628182.instruction: Design hook system: pre_init, post_init, pre_save, post_save, template_render. Create Plugin base class with register_hooks() method. Implement plugin discovery loading from plugins/ directory. Add plugin configuration UI in admin panel. Create secure sandbox for plugin execution. Build Plugin API: register_route, add_menu_item, add_widget, filter_content. Develop sample plugins: ContactForm, SocialShare, SEOOptimizer, Analytics.

1783294271.6283097.instruction: Build CRUD API for pages and posts. Implement slug generation and URL routing. Create content states: draft, published, scheduled, archived. Add revision history with diff view. Integrate Markdown editor with live preview. Build category and tag management. Implement featured image handling. Add SEO meta fields: title, description, keywords, og:image. Create content search with full-text indexing.

1783294271.6284435.instruction: Create media upload endpoint with validation (types: jpg,png,gif,pdf,doc; max size: 10MB). Implement image processing with Pillow: resize, crop, thumbnail generation. Build media library browser with pagination. Add drag-and-drop upload support. Create storage backends: LocalStorage, S3Storage, AzureStorage. Implement image optimization (WebP conversion). Add media organization with folders. Generate responsive image srcsets.

1783294271.6285775.instruction: Implement SSL/TLS certificate handling. Add HTTPS redirect middleware (HTTP to HTTPS). Configure security headers: Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options. Implement CSRF token validation. Add XSS filtering for user input. SQL injection prevention via parameterized queries. Build rate limiting middleware. Add security audit logging for sensitive operations.

1783294271.628715.instruction: Create React-based admin interface with routing. Build dashboard with stats widgets: total posts, users, media size, recent activity. Implement user management UI with role assignment. Create content editor with media picker. Build plugin manager (install/activate/deactivate). Add theme customizer with live preview. Develop REST API with Flask-RESTful: /api/v1/posts, /api/v1/pages, /api/v1/users. Generate OpenAPI/Swagger documentation.

1783294271.628862.instruction: Implement multi-level caching: Redis for query results, filesystem for templates, memory for config. Add database query optimization with eager loading. Configure static file serving with WhiteNoise. Implement Gzip compression middleware. Add database indexing for common queries. Create Dockerfile with multi-stage build. Write docker-compose.yml with PostgreSQL and Redis. Create systemd service file. Write deployment guide for production.
